findings.text: errorPrevLine sets pos.Start = lx.pos - 1 without checking if lx.pos is 0; if an error occurs at the very start of input (e.g., empty file or control char at position 0), Start becomes -1 causing invalid position reporting.
errorf's EOF handling sets pos.Start = lx.pos - 1 without bounds check; if atEOF is true at position 0 (empty file), Start becomes -1, producing invalid error position.
errorControlChar calls errorPos with lx.pos-1; if a control character appears at position 0, the start offset becomes -1, corrupting error position data.

1.reason: This finding describes the same root cause as the reference bug: errorf's EOF handling sets pos.Start = lx.pos - 1 without bounds check, which is exactly the mechanism described in the reference bug.

2.reason: This finding describes the same root cause as the reference bug: errorControlChar calls errorPos with lx.pos-1, which is the same mechanism of setting Start to lx.pos-1 without bounds check, as described in the reference bug.
